justification: Adds a non-blocking 'skip' verdict to the DCP review queue. Standard: one additive migration, one API route, no change to what the commit publishes.

pre_impl.existing_data: Live constraint allowed pending,in_progress,approved,rejected,needs_info,superseded; Waverley queue 7,062 approved and 256 rejected non-rule rows
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: rejected blocks the commit by design, so non-rule text could not be left out without blocking the chapter
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Only rows a reviewer marks skip, from deploy

functions.name: POST /api/dcp-review/chapter
functions.input: a reviewer action, council and chapter key from the review page
functions.output: the count of queue rows given that verdict
functions.if_none: 404 when no row of that chapter is in an updatable status

values.guard_at: blocking list names pending, in_progress, needs_info and current rejected only
values.if_missing: row stays in its old status

queries.purpose: record one reviewer verdict for every open row of one chapter
queries.sql: UPDATE dcp_review_queue SET status = $1, reviewed_by = $2 ... WHERE council = $4 AND chapter_key = $5 AND status = ANY($6::text[])
queries.where_clause: council = $4 AND chapter_key = $5 AND status = ANY($6) - one chapter, only statuses the action may change
queries.if_empty: 404 no pending rows for that chapter

break_it.scenario: Approve sent on a chapter that already has rejected rows
break_it.what_happens: Rejected rows stay rejected; only skip may re-label them

break_it.scenario: Skip is used before migration 124 is applied
break_it.what_happens: The update fails the CHECK and the route returns 500; no row changes
break_it.repro: apply_migration_dry_run.py rolled back shows the old constraint

break_it.scenario: A skipped row could be published by the commit
break_it.what_happens: Not published: the commit reads status approved only

break_it.scenario: Record one reviewer verdict for every open row of one chapter but the chapter has none open
break_it.what_happens: The update touches 0 rows and the route answers 404 instead of a silent success

falsifiable_check.fails_when: skip mapping removed: the skip test fails with 400
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Before this change 'skip' returned 400 invalid action

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes - apply migration 124 before using skip: python scripts/apply_migration_dry_run.py migrations/124_dcp_review_queue_skipped_status.sql --apply
